title: Review the depreciation schedule — Sorrel LLC
instructions: A staff accountant prepared Sorrel LLC's 2025 depreciation schedule. Compare it with the source documents. Tick each amount that is wrong and enter the correct amount, then resolve the diagnostics. Sorrel elected out of bonus depreciation for every class and took no §179.

exhibits.title: Source documents
exhibits.content:
| Asset | Invoice date | Placed in service (installation report) | Cost |
|---|---|---|---:|
| Computer equipment (5-year) | September 15 | September 20 | 60,000 |
| Machine (7-year) | October 28 | November 12 | 240,000 |
| Office furniture (7-year) | January 20 | February 2 | 40,000 |
| Office building leased to tenants (nonresidential) | June 3 | June 10 | 900,000, including land of 150,000 |

exhibits.title: Prepared schedule (half-year convention)
exhibits.content:
| Asset | Rate or life used | 2025 depreciation |
|---|---|---:|
| Computer equipment | 20.00% | 12,000 |
| Machine | 14.29% | 34,296 |
| Office furniture | 14.29% | 5,716 |
| Building (basis 750,000) | 27.5 years, mid-month | 14,773 |
| **Total** | | **66,785** |

Diagnostic: *More than 40% of personal property was placed in service in the fourth quarter.*

rows.label: Percentage of personal property placed in service in Q4
rows.explanation: 240,000 ÷ 340,000 = **70.6%**. The preparer computed it correctly but didn't apply it. **No error.**

rows.label: Computer equipment (5-year)
rows.explanation: Mid-quarter applies to all 2025 personal property. Placed in service September 20 (Q3): 15% × 60,000 = **9,000**.

rows.label: Building depreciation
rows.explanation: Nonresidential rental real property is **39-year**, not 27.5: 750,000 ÷ 39 × 6.5 ÷ 12 (June, mid-month) = **10,417**.

rows.label: The fourth-quarter diagnostic
options: Apply the mid-quarter convention to all 2025 personal property
Apply the mid-quarter convention only to the fourth-quarter assets
No change — the half-year convention can be elected
Include the building in the 40% test and recompute
rows.answer: Apply the mid-quarter convention to all 2025 personal property
rows.explanation: When more than 40% of the year's depreciable personal property is placed in service in Q4, **every** personal-property asset placed in service that year uses the mid-quarter convention. Real property is excluded from the test.

rows.label: Which date determines the machine's quarter?
options: The date it was installed and ready for use
The date the invoice was paid
rows.answer: The date it was installed and ready for use
rows.explanation: An asset is placed in service when it is ready and available for its specific use — here November 12.

rows.label: The building's recovery period
rows.explanation: A building leased to commercial tenants is nonresidential real property: **39 years**. 27.5 years is for residential rental property; 40 years is the ADS life.
